title: Twid
tagline: Live streaming app with ability to upload reels and watch past livestreams
description: This project is built on top of livepeer which allows streaming and stream recording functionalities. We also built a feature for reels. You can watch and upload short videos for your audience to enjoy. The idea behind is to have one of the simplest content creators' app so that we can have so many people onboard.
how_its_made: We used livepeer for transcoding the live video. For storage, we took use of web3.storage which will allow us to store users' profile information and upload all the reels. While live streaming people can interact with one another through the chat section so that we don't have a boring experience.
